x: Harwood, the winner, had established a clear lead after about a mile and was never challenged. Footer now led Pyer by about 15 yards, and the two of them were making a plucky show.
Harwood, Surrey A.C., and Stansbury, Ranelagh A.C., the eventual winner, were running together at this point, with Mitchell lying third, twenty yards behind.
After a mile, however, Harwood, of Surrey A.C., who had just returned from abroad after a spell in the Army, had a lead of about 40 yards with Weatherill, of S.L.H., and myself next.

Harwood and Matthews of Guildford made it quite clear at the start that they had no intention of relinquishing their unbeaten record, especially on their home course, but Hampshire and Cocks had other ideas.
